subject: Mobile Development
title: Multi-Touch: The Breakthrough Input
description: A quick win: understand Multi-Touch: The Breakthrough Input.

hook.text: Before the iPhone, touchscreens needed a stylus. Apple made them work with fingers.

buildup.text: Multi-touch could detect multiple fingers at once — enabling pinch, zoom, and rotate.

discovery.text: Apple didn't invent multi-touch, but they made it reliable and delightful for consumers.

twist.text: Steve Jobs filed aggressive patents on multi-touch gestures, locking out competitors.

climax.text: Multi-touch became the standard input for every smartphone, tablet, and kiosk.

punchline.text: Fingers replaced every stylus on Earth.

quiz.question: What did multi-touch allow that single-touch didn't?
